task: Review this fictional clinical-summary sentence from a patient communication exercise. Identify whether the stated benefit can be attributed to the composite endpoint as a whole or to any of its individual components, given the supplied information.
input: The treatment reduced the composite endpoint of hospitalisation, emergency visits, and mortality by 18 percent.

facts.text: The fictional study reports an 18 percent reduction in a composite endpoint.
The composite endpoint comprises three components: hospitalisation, emergency visits, and mortality.
The packet does not supply the individual event rates for each component.
The packet does not state which components drove the composite reduction.

forbidden_additions: Invented component-level event rates or reduction figures.
A clinical recommendation based on the composite reduction.
A claim that mortality specifically was or was not reduced.
preserve: The distinction between a composite-endpoint result and its component attribution.
The identification that individual component contributions are not supplied.
The 18 percent figure as applying to the composite, not to any single component.
